recordedFrom: autobahn.yml run 36297620675, this branch, ubuntu-24.04: 251 of 257 evaluated framing cases passed and 6 failed. That is 3 more passing and 3 fewer failing than the previous recording, and the gate names the three that moved: 5.19, 5.20, and 7.1.1 now pass and are removed here. All three were inbound-echo cases, and all three were failing because of the shared inbound ring rather than of the close or fragment path: a connection that closed with messages still staged left a record no consumer could ever match, and because the ring is strictly FIFO that stranded head stalled the next case on the same shard. Purging on the close event fixed all three at once, which is also the evidence that they shared one cause.

1.reason: Six valid text and binary payloads were closed with 1009 where the suite expects a clean echo. The cause was the compiled cap, not a misapplied check: the vendored zslay validator refuses payload_len > max_frame_len and message_capacity was 32768 against a largest-in-group payload of 65536. message_capacity is now 65536, and the harness derives the capacity model from engineLimits().messageBytes rather than restating the number, so the selection follows the constant. Expected to pass on the next recorded run; not removed here because only that run can prove it.
